KD SONDAJ

Direct answers

What depths does KD Sondaj work at?

Corporate borehole capacity is 250–3000 metres. Catalogue headings use 300–3000 metres. The geothermal reference scope lists 1200–2600 m.

Which services does KD Sondaj provide?

Petroleum drilling, water well drilling, soil study, observation wells, mineral core drilling, geotechnical survey, geothermal drilling, and water search and locating.

Which rigs are used for geothermal drilling?

For high depth the catalogue shows the 1500–3000 m trailer, 1000–1200 m truck/trailer and the 2500 m special build. Final choice follows formation and mast load.

How is rig capacity chosen?

Target depth, carrier type (trailer/truck), mast and drawworks hook-load, and mud hydraulics are calculated collectively according to engineering standards.

What information is needed for a water-well project?

Target depth, well purpose, province and formation notes if known. Phone or email is enough; the site does not store a form.

Which regions does KD Sondaj serve from Ankara?

Headquarters are in Çankaya / Ankara. Operational range covers DSI regional basins, Aegean and Central Anatolia geothermal fields, and international overseas projects.
